spec_features.spec_quote: A real `give_up` exit. We give the agent a legitimate, low-friction way to stop.
spec_features.evidence: give_up is a real tool: schema in sandbox.py:55-64; Sandbox.give_up returns ToolResult(gave_up=True) (sandbox.py:171-172); dispatched in Sandbox.dispatch (sandbox.py:189-190). The agent loop reads res.gave_up (agent.py:101-102) and on gave_up sets stop_reason='agent_stopped' and breaks the turn loop (agent.py:124-126). End-to-end enforced: dispatched AND honored as a stop.
spec_features.notes: Fully wired and honored as an episode terminator.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We do give it a clean exit (`give_up`) so abandonment is a real choice rather than a forced artefact of the harness.

spec_features.evidence: agent.py run_episode iterates `for turn_idx in range(max_turns):` (agent.py:65) with a `for...else` that sets transcript.stop_reason='max_turns' when the loop completes without break (agent.py:127-128). max_turns is config-driven: RunConfig.max_turns default 12 (runner.py:37), passed to run_episode (runner.py:72), overridable via CLI (cli.py:55-56) and configs (vendors.json max_turns 12, mock.json 10). The cap actually bounds and ends execution.
spec_features.notes: A genuine enforced loop cap that ends the episode.
